title: One chachma from the Essence to the hand: the particular united with the whole
overview:
What was shown of the will, chapter 8 shows of *chachma*, the *middos*, thought, speech and action. One *chachma* creates, forms and makes. It comes down through cause and effect, world by world, but the *memutzaim* (intermediaries) "don't really count", as the *chachma* in Betzalel's hands is the *chachma* in his brain. That is why the doing proves the *chachma*: the prototype that blows up shows the flaw in the concept, and a financial genius should be rich. Shlomo's wisdom, the Holy of Holies and the *chesed* we ask for all come from the Essence itself, and for Him there is no difference between first and last, as for Michelangelo the worm is no less than the king.

The second class takes it into the physical world. Whatever happens is *mamash* the *Aibershter* doing it, as a murder is blamed on the man and not the knife, though a person, unlike a knife, can choose not to be the instrument. The contemplation ends in a *kitzur muflag*, the child's "he hit me": *Malchus* of the *Ein Sof* is *Malchus* of *Asiya*, "I have not changed."

sections.title: Chachma, like the will, comes down from the Essence through every world (not read in class)
sections.summary: As with *Keser* and the simple will, *chachma* too is contracted from the Essence and drawn down through every world to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*: "You made them all with wisdom." The recorded class begins after these lines.

sections.title: One chachma creates, forms and makes: the proof is in the doing
sections.summary: The *chachma* that comes down from *Beriya* to *Yetzira* to *Asiya* is one and the same *chachma*, as the plans and the factory are one *chachma* of the airplane. That is why the doing is what proves the *chachma*, and why the intermediaries between the brain and the hands "don't really count".

phrases.he: כי כמו שכתוב בראשית, בחכמתא ברא,
כך בחכמה יצר ועשה
כמו ברצון, שברא ויצר ועשה הכל ברצון אחד
רק שנשתלשל וירד מעולם הבריאה לעולם היצירה
ומעולם היצירה לעשיה בירידת מדריגות עילה ועלול
כמו ממלכות דכתר דבריאה נעשה כתר ליצירה כו'
כך בחכמה אחד ברא ויצר ועשה
רק שירד ונשתלשל מבריאה ליצירה כו'
דהיינו שנמשך מבחינת מלכות שבחכמה דבריאה לחכמה שבמלכות דיצירה
phrases.en: *Malchus* of *chachma* becomes *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Yetzira*.

blocks.text: Just as He created, formed and made everything with one will, so with one *chachma*. It only comes down by a *hishtalshelus* (chain of descent), cause and effect, world to world, as *Malchus* of *Keser* of *Beriya* becomes *Keser* of *Yetzira*. Yet it is one *chachma*.

blocks.title: The airplane prototype that blows up
blocks.text:
Take the *sechel* (intellect) for building airplanes. First there is the *etzem* of the *sechel*, the concept, which brings the idea into being from nothing. It goes into the *bina* of studying aerodynamics and whatever, then through a *hishtalshelus* into *Yetzira*, where you sit and make plans, and finally to the *chachma* of making the airplane in the factory. And it is *mamash* the same *chachma*.

The proof: if you cannot make the airplane, there is a flaw in your original *chachma* of *Atzilus*, and it is back to the planning board. They make a prototype, it goes up in the air and blows up: the wings come off from the air pressure.

What does it mean? The *chachma* of *Asiya* did not work, and that shows on the *chachma* of *Atzilus*, because they are not different *chachmos*. It is all one *chachma*, even though there is a *hishtalshelus*.

blocks.title: The scientific method
blocks.text: This, by the way, is the whole scientific method. It starts with abstract concepts, like gravity, and finally has to be put into a laboratory experiment, applied in *Asiya*. If the application does not work, the theory was wrong. The theory is in *bina*, a *sevara* (a line of reasoning), already the world of *Beriya*; but if it fails, the original concept in *chachma* was wrong too. So all the *chachmos* are one and the same.

it is drawn from *Malchus* of *chachma* of *Beriya* to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Yetzira*, with a whole bunch of levels in the middle: to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Beriya*, down to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Malchus*, which becomes *chachma* of *Keser* of *Yetzira*, and finally down to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Yetzira*.

phrases.he: ועל דרך זה מיצירה לעשיה
עד חכמה שבמלכות דעשיה
phrases.en: the *chachma* of the actual making of the thing.

phrases.he: שעל זה אמר כולם בחכמה עשית,
phrases.en: You made them all with a *chachma*.

phrases.he: וכן יהו״ה בחכמה יסד ארץ
phrases.en: With *chachma* He actually made this actual earth.

phrases.he: וכהאי גוונא

blocks.text: down to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*: the *chachma* of the actual making of the thing. Of this it says **"You made them all with a *chachma*."**

blocks.title: The financial genius who is not rich
blocks.text: Say a guy is a financial genius. If he is such a big financial genius, how come he is not rich? In any *chachma* you expect it to come out, that you can do it: it is *davka* the *Asiya* of the thing that proves the *chachma*.

blocks.title: Napoleon and the war-game simulator
blocks.text: Or a genius in war tactics, like Napoleon: how do you know he was one? Look at what he did. Not everybody gets to apply his genius in war, but at least he should be able to do it in a computer game. If someone tells the army they have a genius in war tactics they should use, how will they test him? *Davka* through *Asiya*: they put him on a war-game simulator to see if he can win. The same with a genius in chess, whatever the thing: it is all one *chachma*.
"*Havaya* with *chachma* founded the earth": with *chachma* He actually made this actual earth. That means the whole *chachma* of how plants work, how animals work and how everything is put together.

phrases.he: (והגם שדרך פרט הרי משתלשל מבחינת מלכות דמלכות דבריאה להיות כתר ליצירה
phrases.en: Really it goes from *chachma* of *Beriya*, is *mishtalshel* to *Malchus* of *Beriya*, and from *Malchus* of *Beriya* it's *mishtalshel* to become *Keser* of *Yetzira*.

phrases.he: והחכמה דיצירה ממלכות דכתר דיצירה,
phrases.en: And then the *chachma* of *Yetzira* comes from *Malchus* of *Keser* of *Yetzira*.

phrases.he: מכל מקום
phrases.en: But nonetheless,

phrases.he: דרך כלל כל בחינת עילה ועלול מעולם לעולם
נמשך מזה לזה שלא על ידי צמצום רבוי הממוצעים שביניהם
phrases.en: it really comes without *hishtalshelus*; the *memutzaim* don't really count.

blocks.text: In the particular way, *chachma* of *Beriya* comes down to *Malchus* of *Beriya*, which becomes *Keser* of *Yetzira*, and *chachma* of *Yetzira* comes from *Malchus* of *Keser* of *Yetzira*. Nevertheless, in the general way, from world to world it is drawn not through the contraction of the many *memutzaim* (intermediaries) between them.

blocks.title: The chachma in Betzalel's hands
blocks.text:
Betzalel was a *chacham* (a wise man): he had the *chachma* of making artistic things. The *chachma* in his hands comes through the nerves and so on, a whole *hishtalshelus*. But really it is not like that: it is *mamash* the *chachma* in his brain that is doing it. It comes down without *hishtalshelus*.

In the particular way it does have to come step by step: if it does not go from the inner brain to the outer brain, to the nerves, to this, to that, and finally into the hands, he cannot make it. But nonetheless it comes without *hishtalshelus*: the *memutzaim* do not really count.

sections.title: Shlomo's wisdom and the Holy of Holies: all from the chachma of the Essence
sections.summary: The *chachma* G-d gave Shlomo came down through every level, from the *chachma* in the Essence to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, and so did the light of the Holy of Holies, which rested on a physical Ark. So we ask for *daas* "from You".

phrases.he: כמו ויהו״ה נתן חכמה לשלמה, שהיה בעולם העשיה
הרי נמשך השפעה זו מחכמה שבעצמיות אור אין סוף
לחכמה דאדם קדמון
ומחכמה דאדם קדמון לחכמה סתימאה דעתיק יומין ואריך אנפין
ומשם לאור אבא דאצילות
עד בחינת חכמה שבמלכות דאצילות
ומשם לחכמה שבמלכות דבריאה
וכן על דרך זה מבריאה ליצירה ומיצירה לעשיה,
עד שבא האור ושפע חכמה אלהי״ת הזאת בנשמת שלמה מחכמה שבמלכות דעשיה

blocks.text: "And *Havaya* gave *chachma* to Shlomo," who was in the world of *Asiya*. It came from the *chachma* in the Essence of the *Or Ein Sof*, through *Adam Kadmon*, *Atik* and *Arich*, *Abba* of *Atzilus*, and down world by world to *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, into his soul. It is all *tzimtzum*, but the *chachma* nonetheless came from upstairs: it is all connected.

phrases.he: וכן בהיכל קדש הקדשים שבבית המקדש
האיר מכתר וחכמה שבעצמיות
עד בחינת כתר וחכמה שבהיכל קדש קדשים דעשיה
בלוחות וארון גשמיים שהיו עומדים בהיכל קדש קדשים הבנוי למטה,
היה שורה מכתר וחכמה דהיכל קדש קדשים דעשיה הרוחניות כו'

blocks.text: Here he gives a slightly different *shita* (view) than the *Tanya*, which says the Holy of Holies had its light directly from *Malchus* of *Atzilus* and *Beriya*, not dressed in *Yetzira* and *Asiya*. You could say the *Tanya* means the second Temple; but here he says the physical Tablets and Ark, which were only in the first. So it is both ways: it really was without *hishtalshelus*, and yet it came down into an actual physical Ark, out of *Malchus* of *Asiya*.

phrases.he: (וכך אנו מבקשים, אתה חונן לאדם דעת כו'
וחננו מאתך דוקא כו'
phrases.en: Give us *daas* from Your *daas*.

phrases.he: ודי למבין)

blocks.text: "grant us from You." Why would it say that? Why does it not say: give us *daas* from the *daas* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*? It says: give us *daas* from Your *daas*.

sections.title: In man too: one hischakmus from deep study to business, and no difference between first and last
sections.summary: The same mind that does pure analysis solves the problem at work and runs a business: it is all one *hischakmus*. Why the smart are not rich is a matter of *daas*. And as for the artist the worm is no less than the king, for Him there is no difference between first and last.

phrases.he: (ועל דרך משל הנה יובן באדם התחתון,
כמו שחכמתו העצמיות ההיולית
כולל כל הסתעפות התפשטות אור חכמתו,
עד לחוץ מעצמות שלו לגמרי
והוא עד שכל המלובש בעשיה גשמית,
phrases.en: Which is like when he's making an actual thing: the *sechel* is *mluvash* in the power of his hands.

phrases.he: נבדלת לגמרי
ואין הפרש אצלו בין התפשטות חכמתו העצמיות בעצם שכלו להשכיל עיון שכלי,
להתפשטות שלה בעשיה נבדלת

blocks.text: by way of analogy it is understood in man below. When a man makes something, it is really the *chachma* in his brain: "dead dogs don't bark." Take his brain out of his head, and his hands will not be able to make that beautiful thing anymore.
down to the intellect dressed in physical action: when he makes an actual thing, the *sechel* is dressed in the power of his hands. Yet for him there is no difference. The same brain is being used.

blocks.title: The problem at work
blocks.text: Right now we are doing an *iyun* (intellectual analysis) with no application whatsoever. Later a problem comes up at work, some physical thing you have to figure out. Anybody understands it is not a different *sechel*. A guy who is smart at this *iyun* is also going to be smart at solving problems that need *sechel*, because it is the same *sechel*, inner *iyun* or external physical problem.

phrases.he: שהכל נקרא בשם התחכמות אחד,
phrases.en: It's all called "he's a smart guy."

phrases.he: אלא שזה ברוחניות ובעצמותו יותר,
phrases.en: So this one is more a *ruchnius* thing and more inside of himself.

phrases.he: ובעשיה בא בדבר נבדל
phrases.en: In *Asiya*, it comes into a separate thing.

phrases.he: עד שלגבי בחינת העצמות ממש הרי הכל רק התחכמות אחד,
phrases.en: As far as he's concerned, it's all one *hischakmus*.

phrases.he: רק שהולכת ומתפשטת מעיון שכלו למדותיו ולמחשבתו,
עד שעושה ממש בחכמתו זו
כמו בהתחכמות בעסק משא ומתן כו')
phrases.en: Like when he tries to be a smart guy with a business.

blocks.text: it is all called one *hischakmus*: he is a smart guy. Only this one is more spiritual and inside himself, and in action it comes into a separate thing. As far as he himself is concerned it is one *hischakmus*, spreading from his mind to his *middos* and thought until he acts with it, as in being smart in business: the same smartness.

blocks.question: As we said, it is davka Napoleon who is a genius. If we are such geniuses, and the same genius applies to money, why don't we have money? The hischakmus that figured out what nobody thought to ask should make us a lot of money. Where is the problem?
blocks.text: In the interest: it is in the *daas*. "The *chachma* we have, the *daas* we don't have."

The other thing: money has to do with an external *mazal* (fortune), with luck. A totally stupid guy can have money just come to him; upstairs, before the *Aibershter*, he is a bigger *chacham* than you.

So why can't we make money? We lack the *daas*. Those who make it are not as smart, but their bigger *daas* in business puts their whole *hischakmus* there. We pay too much attention over here to pay attention over there.

sensitivity.reason: Calls a man who happens to get rich "a totally stupid guy".
sensitivity.publishable:
The other thing: money has to do with an external *mazal* (fortune), with luck. A man with no great intellect can have money just come to him; upstairs, before the *Aibershter*, he is a bigger *chacham* than you.

So why can't we make money? We lack the *daas*. Those who make it are not as smart, but their bigger *daas* in business puts their whole *hischakmus* there. We pay too much attention over here to pay attention over there.

blocks.title: The absent-minded professor
blocks.text: Like the absent-minded professor, an Einstein type of guy: if he is real smart, it goes *davka* to the higher things, and he has no time to bother with the lower ones. He seems to lack the wisdom even to get dressed properly, and goes out in two different color shoes. It affects the *daas*.

It is the same with women, by the way, who have a *bina yeseira* (an extra measure of *bina*): women have less *daas* not because they are stupider, it is that they are smarter. They always think of another detail, so they cannot concentrate as well as a man. It affects the *daas*.

phrases.he: וכמו ויאמר אלהי״ם יהי אור שבדיבור,
ובא לידי מעשה כמו שכתוב ויהי אור
הרי התחלתו מבחינת חכמתו העצמית שבעצמיות המאציל
שהאציל האור ואחר כך ברא ויצר ועשה כו'
וכך הוא בכל פרטי התהוות הנאצלים והנבראים והנוצרים והמעשים מעצמות האין סוף כו'
כולם מיוחדים ומקושרים כל פרטיהם בעצמיות אור אין סוף שבאבי''ע

blocks.text: "Let there be light," and "there was light": the speech came into action, and its beginning is His essential *chachma* in the very Essence of the Emanator. (He notices a *vav* missing in his copy here.) As with will and *chachma*, so with all the *middos*: they are all united and bound with the Essence.

phrases.he: ואין הפרש לגבי עצמו בין ראשון לאחרון כלל
phrases.en: As far as He's concerned... by Him it makes no difference, an angel or a worm.

phrases.he: ואם כן מה שכתוב אני ראשון ואני אחרון
קאי גם בבחינת החכמה שבראש האצילות עד חכמה שבסוף העשיה כו'

blocks.text: there is no difference as far as He is concerned between first and last at all. By Him it makes no difference: an angel or a worm, the same thing.

blocks.title: Michelangelo's battle scene
blocks.text: How can there be no difference between an angel and a worm? Look at a great artist, like Michelangelo, painting a battle scene: the king, a horse, and at the end of the scene a dead body with worms crawling on it. For the artist the king is not more and the worm is not less. The same *chachma* and artistry, sense of beauty and of ratio, feeling for the emotion, the same catching of the *etzem* of the thing, went into the king and into the worm.

blocks.title: The worms were harder
blocks.text: You would think the king must have been so hard to make, and worms would be easier. He tells you, "To tell you the truth, the worms were harder." The king is big and the worms are small; if you understood artistry you would realize the worm was a bigger *chachma*. Look at the fine detail in the background, where you can *mamash* see every detail of the worm; the king, in the forefront, was real easy. *Davka* the worm was hard. By the artist it is all the same thing.

Or the clouds, or the little flower crushed by the horse: to him, making the worm and making the king is exactly the same thing. So for Him there is no difference between first and last, and "I am first and I am last" applies to the *chachma* from the head of *Atzilus* to the end of *Asiya*.

sections.title: The same in the middos, thought, speech and action: really only ten sefiros
sections.summary: As with will and *chachma*, the *middos* of each world are dressed in those of the next, down to the six extremities of *Asiya*, and the *chesed* we ask for here is the *chesed* of the *Ein Sof* itself. Thought, speech and action are the same: all one, and really there are only ten *sefiros*.

phrases.he: וכן יובן על דרך זה
phrases.en: And in the same way this is understood

phrases.he: דרך פרט בחינת יחוד כללי
בבחינת המדות ומחשבה דבור ומעשה
phrases.en: and the same applies to any of the *middos* and even the *levushim*, *machshava*, *dibur* and *maaseh*,

phrases.he: שבכל עולם מד' עולמות דאבי''ע
שמדות דאצילות מתלבשים במדות דבריאה
ומדות דבריאה במדות דיצירה ומדות דיצירה במדות דעשיה,
עד שבחינת ו׳ קצוות דעשיה נעוץ בתחלת הכל,
במדותיו העצמיים שלפני האצילות
שעל זה אמר המתנשא מימות עולם כידוע
והם בחינת ז׳ תחתונים דעתיק יומין
phrases.en: the seven *middos* of *Atik*,

phrases.he: עד ז׳ תחתונים דאדם קדמון
עד מדות שבאור אין סוף עצמו הגנוזות בעצמות שלו ממש

blocks.text: **And in the same way** with the *middos* and the garments, thought, speech and action, in each of the four worlds: the *middos* of *Atzilus* dressed in those of *Beriya*, and on down, until the lowest extremity of *Asiya* is wedged into His essential *middos* before *Atzilus*, the self-*chesed*: the seven lower [*sefiros*] of *Atik Yomin*, up to *Adam Kadmon*, up to the *middos* hidden in the Essence itself.

phrases.he: כמו בחינת חסד שבאור אין סוף עצמו,
שעל זה אמר חסדי יהו״ה כי לא תמנו כו'
phrases.en: It's the *chesed* of the *Aibershter*, that He had mercy on us down here in physical.

phrases.he: בבחינת אין סוף ממש
אנו אומרים יהי חסדך זה עלינו ממש
phrases.en: Your *chesed* should be on us,

phrases.he: בבחינת חסד מצומצם שבמדות דמלכות דמלכות דעשיה שמאיר בעולם הזה כו'
phrases.en: to give us actual help.

blocks.text: "The kindnesses of *Havaya*, that we have not been consumed": the *chesed* of the *Aibershter*, His mercy on us down here in the physical, is the *Ein Sof* itself. "May this kindness of Yours be upon us": as the contracted *chesed* of *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya* that shines in this world, to give us actual help.

phrases.he: וכן מבחינת מחשבה שבעצמותו נמשך עד בחינת מחשבה דמלכות דעשיה, אשר חושב לעשות בפועל ממש
phrases.en: From His *machshava* in *Atzmus* it goes all the way to the thought to do something in actuality.

phrases.he: וכן בדבור ומעשה כו',
phrases.en: And this is all even in *dibur* and *maaseh*.

phrases.he: כי כמו שכל אשר חפץ ברצון העצמות עושה,
כך כל אשר חפץ ברצונו העצמי חושב כו'
רק שיורד ונמשך בהשתלשלות עד חפצו ורצונו ושכלו ומחשבתו בעשיה בפועל ממש כו'
אבל הכל רק רצון ושכל ומדה ומחשבה ומעשה אחד תחשב לגבי בחינת העצמות ממש, כמובן מכל הנ"ל וד"ל.

blocks.text: From His thought in the *Atzmus* (the Essence) it goes all the way down to the thought of doing something in actuality, and so with speech and action, from His inner power of speech and action. It comes down by *hishtalshelus*, but for the Essence itself it is all one will, intellect, *midda*, thought and action.

The basic thing is "ten *sefiros*, ten and not eleven, ten and not nine" (from the *Sefer Yetzira*; he does not remember where he read this explanation of it). There really are only ten *sefiros*, not a hundred. The *chachma* of *chesed* is really in the brain; *chachma* of *Asiya* and *chachma* of *Beriya* are not two *chachmos*. There are only the ten *sefiros* of the *Aibershter*.

They are the same ten on every level. It is not ten of *Atzilus* and ten of *Beriya* and so on, already forty, each of them with ten, already four hundred: there are just ten *sefiros*, that is all. They break down as they come down, but it is really just ten.

sections.title: Even the physical is one chain: they blame the man, not the knife
sections.summary: Every physical particular is bound like a chain to the first source, so whatever is done below is *mamash* done by the *Aibershter* Himself, as a murder is blamed on the man and not on the knife. A person, unlike a knife, has a choice whether to be the instrument.

phrases.he: ואחכ"ז הרי ישכיל האדם בהתבוננותו במי ברא אלה בגשמיות,
איך שלא נבדל גם הפרט היותר אחרון מהמקור הכללי היותר ראשון
גם בכל פרט שבכל דבר ודבר כמו בבריאת שמים או ארץ או כל פרטי חלקי דומם צומח חי ומדבר
איך ששרשם ברוחניות דמלכות דעשיה עד רום המעלות
אחוז וקשור כשלשלת כו'
phrases.en: totally connected.

blocks.text: how even the very last particular is not separate from the very first general source … held and bound like a chain: totally connected. He said Shlomo's *chachma* was connected, though very contracted; but it is so by everybody. It is the *Aibershter*'s *chachma* he is using, because there is only one *chachma*, and the business at the top of the page comes from it too.

blocks.title: "You told him to curse me"
blocks.text: That is what it says: Naval cursed David HaMelech, and David says to the *Aibershter*, "You told him to curse me." This is explained in the *Tanya*, basically.

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב בראשית ברא, בקדמין ובחוכמתא כו'
הרי בחינת כתר וחכמה שבאבי''ע מיוחדים
כך כל פרטיהם המסתעפים מהם במדות ובמחשבה דבור ומעשה שבכל עולם
(שהוא כללות עשר ספירות דכל עולם שהוא עתיק יומין ואריך אנפין ואבא ואימא וזעיר אנפין ונוקבא דאבי״ע(
עד בחינת עשיה דמלכות דעשיה,
נעוץ סופן בתחלת הכל
דכמו שבקדמון האציל כו'
כך בקדמון זה עצמו ברא ויצר ועשה,
כמו שכתוב כל אשר חפץ כו'
phrases.en: Everything that He's *chafetz*.

blocks.text: *Keser* and *chachma* of *Atzilus*, *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* are united, and so are all their particulars, *middos*, thought, speech and action, the ten *sefiros* of each world, down to the action of *Malchus* of *Asiya*: their end is wedged into the beginning of all. With the same *Kadmon* with which He emanated, He created, formed and made.

So by a person: the *ratzon* (will) that moves his hand is not different from the *ratzon* that wants the thing, nor from what he himself wants, the *ratzon* of the *etzem*. What he does with his hand goes on his *etzem*.

blocks.title: They don't blame the bullet
blocks.text: The proof of it is the death penalty. They don't blame the hand; they blame him. And not only do they not blame the hand: they don't blame the bullet.
O.J. Simpson would have had a perfect defense: "I didn't do it, it's obvious that a knife did it." Not a person: a knife.

So here there is a knife too. *Atzilus* is still considered the *gufa d'malka* (the body of the King), but *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* are already like external instruments, *levushim* (garments), and the *kelipos* (husks, the unholy) are *mamash* separate, not even *levushim*.

blocks.title: Mordechai appealed to the wielder of the knife
blocks.text: Even by Haman it does not matter: the Megillah shows the decree was from the *Aibershter*. So, to get rid of the decree, Mordechai did not bow down to Haman; he got the 22,000 children and all that business, and all the Jews to fast. They appealed to the wielder of the knife, not to the knife. Whatever happens, the *Aibershter* *mamash* did it Himself, personally.

blocks.question: Yet Haman was punished, as the Rambam says, and as Hillel says: "because you drowned others, you were drowned." But if the Aibershter did it, why?
blocks.text: The answer comes from Neron (Rabbi Markel first says Nevuzaradan; the class sorts it out next), who said, "Wipe your hands on somebody else." He chose to be the instrument for it. *Harbeh shluchim lamakom*: the Omnipresent has many messengers.

blocks.title: Neron and Nevuzaradan
blocks.text: Who said to wipe your hands on someone else? Rabbi Markel first says Nevuzaradan, then Neron Kesar. A student checks: Nevuzaradan actually killed a million people and finally converted, a story in the Gemara, when he said at Zecharia's grave, "Look at what the punishment is for one person." The one who shot the arrow is Neron.

Whoever it was, though he is the instrument, he is unlike a knife. A knife is totally blameless; a person has choice. Call a knife bad because it killed people, and it can say back, "I had no choice in the matter. I was just used."

A dog can already say he was trained this way, and a dog is basically not punished, but he is still destroyed. And it says the Egyptians were not punished for having enslaved the Jews; they were punished for delighting in it.

A person does not have to go along with what the *Aibershter* uses him as an instrument for. He can make himself an instrument for something else, and the *Aibershter* will figure out already how to do it. He figured out how to destroy Jerusalem, but Neron was not part of it; actually, he converted, too.

Back to the text: with this same *Kadmon* He created, formed and made, down to *Malchus* of *Asiya*, "all that He desired." *Chafetz* is as in *chafetz chesed*, in the *Atzmus*, and it reaches all the way down to actual *Asiya*. *Malchus* of *Atzilus* is like the brain to the hand; *Malchus* of *Asiya*, the hand to the external utensil.

sections.title: The middos and His place: the particular united with the whole, as you blame the man and not his hand
sections.summary: Every emotion in every world has its place and existence from Him, up to "His place", the Essence that holds all worlds. The whole point of the contemplation is to see that it is *mamash* the *Aibershter* doing everything, as plainly as one knows that a punch came from the man and not from his hand.

phrases.he: וכך במדות,
phrases.en: It's the same thing like in the *ratzon*; the same thing is the *middos*.

phrases.he: כמו הנה מקום אתי,
phrases.en: There is a place with me.

phrases.he: בחי' ביטול הו׳ קצוות
לך יהו״ה הגדולה, בכל עולם
לפי מה שהוא
phrases.en: According to this world.

blocks.text: So in the *middos*, as in the *ratzon*. **"There is a place with me."** "Yours, *Havaya*, is the greatness," in every world: the only way you can have an emotion is *Lecha Havaya*. Not only the greatness of *Atzilus* or the Essence: even your own emotion of *chesed* or *gevura*, its place and what gives it existence, is the *Aibershter*, in every world down to the *kelipos*, each according to what it is.

phrases.he: עד בחינת מקום העצמי שנקרא מקומו,
phrases.en: All the way to the *makom ha'atzmi*, which is His place.

phrases.he: וכמאמר רבותינו זכרונם לברכה הוא מקומו של עולם
ואין העולם מקומו
וכן מאמר הידוע דאיהו תפיס בכל עלמין
phrases.en: He holds on to all the worlds,

phrases.he: ולית מאן דתפיס ביה,
אפילו מחשבה ורצון הקדום כו'
phrases.en: even the *machshava kduma*.

blocks.text: up to the essential place called *Mekomo*, His place: the place of the *Aibershter*, the real *Atzmus*; that is "Blessed be the glory of *Havaya* from His place." He holds all the worlds, and none holds Him, not even the *machshava kduma* (the primordial thought), which is the *tehiru tata'a*.

phrases.he: ומכל זה הרי יובן בחינת יחוד וחיבור הפרט אל הכלל דרך כללות הכל מעצמיות אור אין סוף באבי''ע
phrases.en: So from this, you understand that it's a direct connection all the way to the *Aibershter*.

phrases.he: מלבד בחינת היחוד שבכל עולם דרך פרט,
בעשר ספירות שבו כו'
phrases.en: by the *sefiros*, so to speak.

blocks.text: From this you understand it is a direct connection all the way to the *Aibershter*. That is the main thing of the whole *hisbonenus* (contemplation): to understand that it is *mamash* the *Aibershter* doing the whole thing, not just the *pratim* (particulars).

blocks.title: The creature from another dimension
blocks.text: The point is to see the connection of all the *pratim* instantly. Take some weird creature from another dimension with no idea how a person works. He asks why we did not say the knife did it. Because the knife is connected to the hand. Then why not cut off his hand? Because the hand is connected to the heart, the heart to the head, the head to the *ratzon*, which is connected to himself, his soul: so if the knife did it, he did it, and we can kill him.

blocks.title: "I'm mad at your hand"
blocks.text: Someone who knows all this does not have to think about the whole *hishtalshelus*; it is obvious. If somebody punches you, you don't say, "Hey, I'm mad at your hand"; you are mad at him, because you understand how the nerves and muscles go, all from the head and the heart, from the person's own *ratzon*.

By the *Aibershter* it is not so easy to see; that is what the *hisbonenus* is for. Done properly, it brings you back to the *daas* of a small child, who thinks the *Aibershter* is here, invisible. The Mitteler Rebbe said this is "so close to the truth that it's really the truth": *mamash* the *Aibershter* is here doing these things.

Once you understand the *hishtalshelus*, you blame everything on the *Aibershter*, good and bad, except that from Him only good comes: "All that the Merciful One does, He does for good." As the *Tanya* explains, the good from the *alma d'iskasya* (the hidden world) is bigger than the good from the *alma d'isgalya* (the revealed world): the curses in the Torah are actually the bigger blessings.
When we went into exile, this exile is really the *alma d'iskasya* of Moshiach. When you realize it, it will change: the good of the *alma d'iskasya* will come into the *alma d'isgalya*, just as big.

Once you know the *hishtalshelus*, you don't need it anymore. Nobody thinks of hand, arm, heart and brain; he thinks, "He hit me." Instantly: *ani ani hu*, him in his head is him in his hand. Even with a thrown stone, you don't say the stone hit you: it is the *koach hapoel bapeula* (the power of the maker in the deed).

the unification of the particular with the whole: from the stone all the way to the self, the *Aibershter* Himself. Besides the unification in each world in the particular way, in the *sefiros*, so to speak: the ten *sefiros* of the heart are connected to those of the brain, and the *chachma* in the hand to the *chachma* in the head.

blocks.title: The smart pen
blocks.text: Nobody reads a smart scientific paper and concludes that the writer must have a smart hand. That is like saying it is not a smart hand, he has a smart pen: "If I could get a pen like that, I could also be smart."

sections.title: Kitzur muflag: once you know the chain, it is one shot, and "I have not changed"
sections.summary: One who knows the whole chain in detail should still draw his soul to the general unity, until it all comes to him in a *kitzur muflag*, as a child knows his brother hit him. Then *Malchus* of the *Ein Sof* is *Malchus* of *Asiya* in one shot: "I, *Havaya*, have not changed," and His kingship is as strong at the border as in the capital.

phrases.he: אך אף על פי שיודע האדם כל ביאור ההשתלשלות דאבי''ע בפרט,
ימשוך נפשו ליחוד הפרט אל היחוד בכלל,
עד עצמיות אור אין סוף ממש על דרך הנזכר לעיל וכהאי גוונא
מלבד היחוד וביטול כל עולם בפרט לגבי העצמות כו'
phrases.en: Beside the *yichud* of every particular world,

phrases.he: עד שיבוא לו כל ההתבוננות שמרחיב בפרט בענין זה, בקיצור מופלג
phrases.en: until finally, once he really knows his *hisbonenus*, the whole thing will come to him with a *kitzur muflag*.

blocks.text: he should draw his soul to the unification of the particular with the general unification. This takes work only at the start. If you really know the *seder hishtalshelus*, it becomes obvious: when someone throws a stone at you, you do not stop to make the *yichudim*, the stone came from the hand and so on. It is automatic, one shot.

besides the unification and *bittul* of each world in particular. It is as with the heart: if he had a feeling in his heart, you know he had the feeling; if he had a thought in his brain, you know he had the thought.

blocks.title: "He hit me"
blocks.text: until all the contemplation … comes to him in a *kitzur muflag*. At the beginning he has to try; once he really knows his *hisbonenus*, it comes all in one shot. Even a little kid knows that: he comes and says his brother hit him, not his brother's hand: "he hit me." That is a *kitzur muflag*: *ani ani hu*.

phrases.he: כמו מלכותך מלכות כל עולמים
שזהו בחינת מלכות דאין סוף במלכות דמלכות דעשיה
על דרך הנזכר לעיל ברצון וחכמה ומדות כו'
כמו שכתוב ראו כי אני אני הוא ממש
phrases.en: I am the same one at the beginning and the end;

phrases.he: וכן אני יהו״ה לא שניתי
phrases.en: it's not a different *Aibershter* down here.

phrases.he: בחינת אני הוא בחינת מלכות, שהוא בחינת אין דכתר, דנעוץ תחלתן בסופן
phrases.en: The *ayin* of the *Keser* is right away in the *Malchus*.

phrases.he: בכל עולם בפרט וכן דרך כללות הכל
phrases.en: Besides the fact that it goes from the highest *Keser* to the lowest *Malchus*, in every world it is also like that.

blocks.text: "Your kingship is the kingship of all worlds": *Malchus* of the *Ein Sof* and *Malchus* of *Asiya*, one shot. "See now that I, I am He": I am the same one at the beginning and at the end. "I, *Havaya*, have not changed": it is not a different *Aibershter* down here.

in each world in particular it is also so, and that is why it says *Keser Malchus*: the *ayin* of the *Keser* is right away in the *Malchus*. What happened to the *sefiros* in the middle? It is as if they don't exist. He wanted it, and He did it.

phrases.he: ולזה אומר אני יהו״ה לא שניתי,
בין מלכות דאין סוף למלכות דעשיה, כלל
phrases.en: No difference: the same *Aibershter*.

phrases.he: וזה שכתוב מלכותך הוא מלכות כל עולמים
phrases.en: Your *Malchus* is the *Malchus* of all the worlds,

phrases.he: עד מלכות דמלכות דעשיה,
מטעם כל הנזכר לעיל ודי למבין:

blocks.text: "I, *Havaya*, have not changed" between *Malchus* of the *Ein Sof* and *Malchus* of *Asiya*: no difference, the same *Aibershter*. "Your kingship is the kingship of all worlds": the *Malchus* of all the worlds, "from Hodu to Kush".

blocks.title: From Shushan to the border
blocks.text: From Shushan the capital to the far extremities of the kingdom it is all the same *Malchus*. Going away from Shushan does not lessen it at all: it is just as strong by the border, the same law everywhere, down to *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*.

reviewQuestions.question: What does the airplane prototype that blows up show about the *chachma* of *Atzilus* and the *chachma* of *Asiya*?
In what sense does the *chachma* in Betzalel's hands come "without *hishtalshelus*", if it has to pass through the nerves?
If the same *hischakmus* serves deep study and business, why are smart people not always rich?
How does Michelangelo's battle scene explain "there is no difference as far as He is concerned between first and last"?
If whatever happens is the *Aibershter* doing it, as a murder is blamed on the man and not the knife, why was Haman punished?
What is the *kitzur muflag*, and why does the little kid say "he hit me" and not "his hand hit me"?

notes.text: Lines 1-10 are not read in any class of the series: class 056 begins at line 11. Their phrases are a plain rendering, not his.
He says that Naval cursed David and David said "You told him to curse me". The curser in that verse is Shimi ben Gera (II Samuel 16:10-11); left as he said it.
He contrasts the text with "the Tanya" on the Holy of Holies but does not say where in the Tanya; left as he said it.
Class 056 has almost two minutes with no transcribed words between w3124 (24:57) and w3125 (26:47), in the reading of lines 43-44; the reading resumes mid-line. Possibly a pause in the tape.

The Neron/Nevuzaradan exchange is muddled in the recording (who said "wipe your hands on someone else", who converted). As the class settles it: Neron shot the arrow and fled and converted; Nevuzaradan killed many over Zecharia's blood and converted (Gittin 56a-57b). The block keeps the class's own sorting-out.

Class 056 w2136-2154 ("upstairs, it says in front of the Aibershter, he's a bigger chacham than you") is a little compressed; the aside keeps his words: before the Aibershter, the "totally stupid guy" who gets the money is the bigger chacham.
Class 057 w1051-1094: he rereads lines 58-59 with words not in the printed text ("becomes sovev and makif over everything"); the block follows the printed text.
Class 057 has Sofer word times, not re-timed ones; the seconds may be off.
In the reading of line 42 he reads "the lowest extremity" (sof kitzon) where the text has "six extremities" (vav ketzavos); the phrase follows the text.
